summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of Self Journey Card 1 Self-Assessment (save-to-account + branded PDF). 12/12 pytest tests passed covering auth-gated GET/PUT /me, upsert, invalid key & out-of-scale value drop, per-user isolation (parent1 vs parent2), public PDF endpoint with filename/content-type, empty/partial/full+unicode PDFs, and scoring guardrail (tier only when all 30 answered). Frontend E2E (parent1@test.com): dashboard → legal ack → door-self opens Self Journey → door-self-card-assess opens self-assessment-modal; modal hydrates from server (A1=4 pre-checked from backend seed), save-status transitions idle→pending→saved with 'Saved to your account · <time>'; radio clicks correctly update section-B-score, summary-B and total; tier-pending card shows when partial, tier card hidden (guardrail enforced). Download PDF triggers SA_CoParents_Self_Assessment.pdf download. Persistence confirmed: after localStorage.clear() + sessionStorage.clear() + full reload, previously-saved answers (A1=4, D1=4) reappear from server. Esc closes modal and flushes pending save (E1=2 reflected on reopen). Mobile 390px: modal scrollWidth==clientWidth (no horizontal overflow). All regression doors still present on Self Journey view: door-quick-exit, door-safety-first, grey-rock-toggle-chip, door-self-card-relationship, door-self-card-child-needs, door-self-card-foundation.
critical_code_review_comments: self_assessment_routes.py line 80: `next((t for t in CONTENT['tiers'] if total >= t['min']), None)` requires tiers to be ordered highest-min first in content JSON — currently they are (96,76,56,30). If tier order is ever edited this logic silently breaks. Consider `max(..., key=min)` or sorting explicitly to make this intent robust.

POST /self-assessment/pdf is intentionally public (comment confirms). This is a design decision but means an unauthenticated attacker can generate unlimited PDFs — consider lightweight rate-limiting if abuse becomes an issue.

SAFoundation: `going_well`/`improve` default to ['', '', ''] but Pydantic validator doesn't pad short lists. If a client sends only 1 item the UI must handle variable lengths — currently fine but worth a note.
seed_data_creation: Tests overwrite parent1 and parent2 self_assessments collection docs each run; no persistent seed required. After the suite parent1 has answers={A1:4,D1:4,E1:2} roughly (final state depends on test ordering), parent2 has {F1:2}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_self_assessment_api.py works standalone (loads /app/backend/.env + /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv for JWT_SECRET and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Lockstep JSON (backend self_assessment_content.json == frontend selfAssessmentContent.json) verified by diff. All 30 question keys A1..F5 are generated from content. Scoring guardrail: tier is None unless answered==30. Modal data-testids verified live: self-assessment-modal, -close, -save-status[data-status], -<Q>-<v>, -section-<K>-score, -summary-<K>, -total, -tier, -tier-pending, -download-pdf.
